# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 21 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_021_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 21

**21:1** Now when Herod perceived that he had been mocked by the Magi, he was angry and sent his executioners, saying, "Kill all the infants who are two years old and under."

**21:2** And Mary, hearing that the infants were being killed, was afraid and took the infant and wrapped him in swaddling clothes and laid him in a manger.

**21:3** But Elizabeth, hearing that John was being sought, took him and went up into the hill country. And she looked around for a place to hide him and there was no place. And Elizabeth groaned and said aloud, "O mountain of God, receive a mother with her child." For Elizabeth was unable to climb up. And immediately the mountain was split open and received her. And the light shone through the mountain for her, for an angel of the Lord was with them, protecting them.
